queries.result: لم يُعثر على عارض قطع أراضٍ محلي أو واجهة API عامة مجهولة للقرية. وُجدت صفحات الهيئة المصرية العامة للمساحة التي تثبت اختصاصها بالخرائط والسجلات المساحية، وصفحة شراء الخرائط الرقمية، ودليل خرائط الدقهلية؛ ولا توفر هذه الصفحات استعلاماً مجهولاً عن هندسات القطع.

officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official agency history and services describe production of topographic/property maps and ownership books for agricultural land and built property; this establishes a national survey/cadastral custodian, not a local Birimbal public parcel service.

Official digital-map workflow requires a written request specifying location, scale, requested layers, format and projection, followed by inspection, quotation, payment and delivery. No anonymous parcel feature endpoint is advertised.

Official map guide includes Dakahlia at map scales including 1:1,000, 1:2,500 and 1:5,000 and identifies digital/village map production areas; it is map-product evidence, not an open parcel API or target-city parcel extract.
Official geospatial portal lead discovered during research, but the anonymous request timed out in this bounded attempt; contents, schema and coverage remain unverified.
